name: Nain Singh's secret survey to Lhasa
summary: Trained by the Survey of India and disguised as a Ladakhi trader, a schoolmaster from Kumaon walks to Lhasa counting every step on a 100-bead rosary and hiding his compass in a prayer wheel. He fixes the latitude and height of Lhasa and maps the Tsangpo for 800 km.

stops.note: Trained at the Survey's headquarters: 2,000 paces to the mile.
Joins a caravan along the Tsangpo.
Three months in Lhasa; fixes its latitude by the stars from his lodgings.
West along the Tsangpo to its source.
Home with 1,200 miles of route survey.
